fields.name: base_url
fields.doc: Base URL of the API (without trailing slash)

fields.name: endpoints
fields.doc: Endpoint definitions (at least one)

fields.name: default_rate_limit
fields.doc: Max request rate across all endpoints, e.g. "100/s" (count/window; unit s|m|h)

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: Cron expression for recurring runs — the hub scheduler fires it, evaluated in UTC

fields.name: auth
fields.doc: Authentication for every endpoint (omit => none)

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Authentication method

fields.name: username
fields.doc: Username (basic, session)

fields.name: password_env
fields.doc: Password source: lm secret name, else env var (basic, session)

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Header/query parameter name for API key

fields.name: value_env
fields.doc: API key value source: lm secret name, else env var

fields.name: in
fields.doc: Where to place the API key (header|query)

fields.name: token_env
fields.doc: Bearer token source: lm secret name, else env var (bearer)

fields.name: token_value
fields.doc: Literal bearer token (dev only — prefer token_env)

fields.name: scheme
fields.doc: The Authorization header's scheme word (bearer): Bearer by default, Token for Django REST Framework
recommendations: Bearer (the default), or the word the API expects, e.g. Token for Django REST Framework

fields.name: token_url
fields.doc: OAuth2 token endpoint (client-credentials grant)

fields.name: client_id
fields.doc: OAuth2 client id

fields.name: client_secret_env
fields.doc: OAuth2 client secret source: lm secret name, else env var

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: OAuth2 scope, space-separated

fields.name: client_auth
fields.doc: How the OAuth2 client authenticates to the token endpoint (basic | post)
recommendations: basic (the default) sends the client id and secret as HTTP Basic; post puts them in the body

fields.name: login_url
fields.doc: Where the login form posts: Spring Security's /login, the container's j_security_check

fields.name: prime_url
fields.doc: The page GET first, for the session cookie and the CSRF token; login_url by default

fields.name: username_field
fields.doc: The form's username field (j_username for the container's login)

fields.name: password_field
fields.doc: The form's password field (j_password for the container's login)

fields.name: csrf_field
fields.doc: The hidden input carrying the CSRF token in the primed page (_csrf under Spring Security)

at_least_one_of.hint: Use `lm secret set <NAME> ...` then reference via token_env: <NAME>

fields.name: tls
fields.doc: Trust an internal CA for every endpoint: {ca_secret: the lm secret holding its PEM certificate(s)}

fields.name: ca_secret
fields.doc: Name of the lm secret holding the CA's PEM certificate(s); only those CAs are trusted

fields.name: http_version
fields.doc: HTTP version every request asks for: "1.1" or "2" (omit => negotiated, HTTP/2 when the server offers it)

fields.name: headers
fields.doc: Static headers sent on every request, [{name, value | value_env}]
recommendations: headers is a list of { name, value|value_env } objects

fields.name: defaults
fields.doc: Per-endpoint defaults merged into each endpoint

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it on each endpoint

fields.name: query
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it on each endpoint

fields.name: base_url
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.base_url

fields.name: auth
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.auth

fields.name: tls
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.tls

fields.name: http_version
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.http_version

fields.name: default_rate_limit
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.default_rate_limit

fields.name: graphql_path
fields.doc: Not accepted in spec.defaults — refused by validation; declare it at spec.graphql_path

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Not accepted here — refused by validation; declare the mapping on its endpoint

fields.name: response_format
fields.doc: What the answer is: json (the default) or xml — attributes under @, text beside them under #text

fields.name: incremental
fields.doc: Incremental strategy (mode full | watermark; defaults to full)
recommendations: incremental is a block, not a scalar: incremental: { mode: watermark, param: ..., watermark_path: ... }

fields.name: headers
fields.doc: Not accepted here — refused by validation; declare headers at spec.headers
recommendations: Move the headers block up to spec.headers (connector level)

fields.name: variables
fields.doc: Static variables sent with every request; the relay cursor is injected on top

fields.name: header
fields.doc: The SOAP header template (inner <Header> content; same placeholders as body)

fields.name: soap_action
fields.doc: Sent as the SOAPAction header (an empty quoted string when absent)

fields.name: graphql_path
fields.doc: Path appended to base_url for GraphQL endpoints

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Fence scheduled runs to a UTC time window, HH:MM-HH:MM (a manual run bypasses it)

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Not accepted here — refused by validation; declare the mapping on its endpoint
